assessment: In an integrative way, the authors introduced an exceptional Konservat-Lagerstätte jointly preserving dinosaur remains and fossiliferous amber. Impressively, this is the first time that strictly in situ amber is reported, and the key claims of the manuscript are well supported by the paleontological and geochemical data. This manuscript will be of broad interest to scientists, including paleontologists, geobiologists, ecologists and geologists, as well as the public.
